Oh and also searching for a #Webdev that can reduce the amount of code required to generate this page. Ideally something that is way simpler.

There currently is an unholy amount of 3rd party code that I have never looked at and not really know what it does involved in generating this Jekyll page.

Open for recommendations that will cut it down even more.

Non goals:
* Introducing (new) 3rd party dependencies
* it being more complicated than now.
* php or anything non-static content.

#webdesign
